profile.headline: Software Engineer | Data Acquisition & Analysis | Computer Science Graduate Student at Georgia Tech
profile.summary:
I'm a Software Engineer with a background in Systems/Network Administration in the Greater Philadelphia area.

In addition to my full-time position I am a full-time graduate student pursuing my Master of Science in Computer Science with a concentration in Computing Systems from the Georgia Institute of Technology (Georgia Tech).

company.name: Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division

positions.title: Systems Administrator
positions.description:
Provides advice and direction to users, and manage IT team projects involving highly complex systems. 

Evaluation of new technologies, developing standardized practices for the implementation of an Active Directory environment that supports a multitude of users. 

Designs platform upgrades and large scale system integrations. 

Supports an Active Directory environment, including activities such as: design, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

Handles ongoing maintenance, such as: service pack installations, hot fixes, and software upgrades. 

Maintains a working knowledge of server technologies and network and enterprise storage technologies. 

Generates innovative approaches and solutions to recurring tasks and projects.

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist
positions.description:
Installs, operates, and performs unit maintenance on multi-functional/multi-user information processing systems and peripheral equipment and auxiliary devices. Performs input/ output data control and bulk data storage operations.

Transfers data between information processing equipment and systems. 

Troubleshoots automation equipment and systems to the degree required for isolation of malfunctions to specific hardware or soft ware. 

Restores equipment to operation by replacement of line replaceable unit (LRU). 

Installs, operates, performs strapping, restrapping, checks and services, and unit level maintenance on communication security devices. 

Modifies existing application packages using application and operating system software and appropriate computer language commands and files.

positions.title: Signal Support Systems Specialist
positions.description:
Management of records, printing and publications for the Brigade and Battalion

Install and manage Visual Information Systems (video teleconference)

Provide computer repair and network automations management and support for the Brigade and Battalion.

Provide telephone control for the Brigade and Battalion

Maintain reporting accountability of signal sensitive items for HQ and HQ Company

positions.title: Technical Support Representative (MyWebsite Support Team)
positions.description:
Handled an average of 40­-60 inbound calls per day.

Assisted customer’s in all aspects of the MyWebsite software

Assisted customer’s with design aspects of their websites as well as familiarization with the MyWebsite product

Operated as a member of a custom coding team which facilitated requests with a varying degree of difficulty using Javascript, Jquery, CSS, and HTML
